title: Tic Tac Toe Routines
description: Tic Tac Toe Routines. 2 recovered saves.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: TIC TAC TOE ROUTINES
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, normal end; exact match across original and both-channel variants; runtime untested
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.

1000 ' FLIP ON HORZ
1010 FORC=1TO3STEP2
1020 X$=B$(C,1):B$(C,1)=B$(C,2):B$(C,2)=X$:X$=""
1030 NEXT
2000 ' FLIP ON VERT
2010 FORC=1TO3STEP3
2020 X$=B$(1,C):B$(1,C)=B$(2,C):B$(C,2)=X$:X$=""
2028 FORF=1TO3
2030 NEXT:RETURN
3000 'PRINT BOARD
3010 IFM=1THENGOSUB1000ELSE IFM=2THENGOSUB2000ELSEIFM=3THENGOSUB1000:GOSUB2000
3020 PRINT@0,"";
